channel.title: WebEaze Blog
channel.description: Practical guides for small business owners on web design, local SEO, Google Business Profile, and getting more customers online.

item.title: Why Your Small Business Isn't Showing Up on Google
item.description: If your business is hard to find on Google, there are usually a handful of fixable reasons. Here is how to figure out which ones are holding you back.

item.title: How to Get More Google Reviews for Your Small Business
item.description: Google reviews influence whether people click your listing or your competitor's. Here is a practical, repeatable system for getting more of them without being pushy.

item.title: Small Business Website Checklist: 12 Things Every Site Needs
item.description: A practical checklist covering the 12 things every small business website needs to turn visitors into customers and rank well on Google.

item.title: What Makes a Good Small Business Website?
item.description: Five things that actually separate a website that wins customers from one that gets ignored, based on what real visitors do when they land on a small business site.

item.title: How to Get Your Business on Google Maps
item.description: A step-by-step guide to getting your small business listed on Google Maps, verifying your profile, and showing up in local searches.

item.title: Google Business Profile vs. Website: Do You Need Both?
item.description: Google Business Profile and a website serve different purposes. Here is what each one does well and why most small businesses need both.

item.title: Web Design for Restaurants: What Actually Brings in Tables
item.description: Most restaurant websites lose customers before they ever walk in the door. Here is what your site actually needs to turn hungry searchers into reservations.

item.title: What Is Local SEO and How Does It Work?
item.description: Local SEO helps your business show up when nearby customers search for what you offer. Here is how it works and what you can do to improve your ranking.

item.title: Should I Use Wix or Squarespace, or Get a Custom Website?
item.description: Wix, Squarespace, and custom websites all have trade-offs. Here is an honest breakdown to help you pick the right one for your business situation.

item.title: How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost?
item.description: Website pricing varies wildly depending on who builds it and how. Here is a clear breakdown of what you can expect to pay across different options.

item.title: Does My Small Business Really Need a Website?
item.description: A lot of small business owners wonder if a website is really worth it in 2026. Here is an honest answer, including when you might be fine without one.
